headline: With only one referral slot, the customer asks to "maximize the bonus" without saying whose bonus; the official TechFlow-to-Sky Blue pick wins on combined bonus but loses to Ember-to-Lime Green on her own bonus.

issues.summary: Unlike task_101, the customer never says "combined". The gold maximizes combined bonus (Sky Blue $150+$250=$400). If "the bonus" means her own referrer bonus, Ember to Lime Green ($200) beats Sky Blue ($150), and Hunter Green ($175) beats it too.
evidence: user instruction 12: "Okay, so if I can only do one right now, which one should I prioritize? I want to maximize the bonus."
task_101 instruction 1 (same persona): "I want to make sure I'm getting the best possible combined bonus" (absent from task_102)
doc_business_checking_accounts_sky_blue_001: "Your bonus: $150 ... Their bonus: $250"; lime_green_003: "Your bonus: $200 ... Their bonus: $150"; hunter_green_001: "Referrer reward: $175"
author notes: "Must choose highest value: TechFlow -> Sky Blue ($400)"
replay: submit_referral "Lime Green Account" -> verified match False (referrals differs)
issues.why_it_matters: A competent agent that reads "maximize the bonus" from the referrer's side recommends Lime Green for Ember. The customer submits it and the referrals table diverges. The NL assertion requiring TechFlow/Sky Blue fails as well.
issues.suggested_fix: Have the customer say "the best combined bonus" (as in task_101), or accept Lime Green when the referrer-bonus reading is used.

solution_check: Rolling window: ref_recent_purple_001 COMPLETE on 11/10 (4 days ago), so one slot. Gold Years 6/6 full; Sky Blue 7/8 (one slot); Ember 5 years old, so no Sky Blue. Highest combined: TechFlow to Sky Blue $400, then Ember to Lime Green $350. Highest referrer-only: Ember to Lime Green $200. Gold matches only the combined reading.
prior_note: The prior Major (a higher-paying referral exists than the gold pick) persists; I frame it as the unstated "whose bonus" target rather than a pure gold error.
notes: reward_basis is DB + NL_ASSERTION. The NL assertion ("recommend TechFlow Labs (not Ember Analytics) for the Sky Blue Account referral") follows the same combined-bonus reading.
